## Analysis summaries and tables



```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# ----------------------------
# 1) Build isolate-level pathotype presence
#    (restricted to potential hybrid pathogens)
# ----------------------------
iso_pathotypes <- focused_VFs %>%
  filter(
    name %in% potential_hybrids$name,
    Present == 1
  ) %>%
  select(name, ST_new, Consensus_phylogroup, pathotype, GENE) %>%
  distinct()

iso_pathotype_binary <- iso_pathotypes %>%
  group_by(name, ST_new, Consensus_phylogroup, pathotype) %>%
  summarise(present = 1, .groups = "drop")

iso_pathotype_wide <- iso_pathotype_binary %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = pathotype,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = 0
  )


hpi_marker_columns <- paste0(
  "ABRICATE..vfdb_",
  c("fyuA/psn", "irp1", "irp2", "ybtA", "ybtE", "ybtP", "ybtQ", "ybtS", "ybtT", "ybtU", "ybtX")
)

iso_gene_flags <- genometa %>%
  filter(name %in% potential_hybrids$name) %>%
  transmute(
    name,

    # ColV marker (already binary)
    ColV = as.integer(ColV == 1),

    # senB (VFDB)
    senB = as.integer(ABRICATE..vfdb_senB == 1),
    
    # HPI: all eleven markers used in the manuscript results.
    HPI = as.integer(if_all(all_of(hpi_marker_columns), ~ .x == 1)),
    
    # stx (VFDB)
    stx = as.integer(ABRICATE..vfdb_stx1A == 1
                      | ABRICATE..vfdb_stx1B == 1
                      | ABRICATE..vfdb_stx2A == 1
                      | ABRICATE..vfdb_stx2B == 1
                      | ABRICATE..vfdb_stxA == 1),
    # intI1 (VFDB)
    intI1 = as.integer(ABRICATE..EC_custom_intI1_HQ730118.1)
  )

iso_gene_flags_amr <-
        amrfinder %>%
        filter(name %in% potential_hybrids$name) %>%
        filter(Scope == "core" & `Element type` == "AMR" & `Element subtype` == "AMR") %>%
        select(name, `Gene symbol`, Class, Subclass) %>%
        mutate(CIA = if_else(`Gene symbol` %in% ARGs_of_interest | Subclass %in% c("CARBAPENEM", "CEPHALOSPORIN"), 1, 0))

iso_amr_summary <- iso_gene_flags_amr %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarise(
    any_AMR = 1L,                                  # has >=1 AMR call
    CIA     = as.integer(any(CIA == 1L)),           # has >=1 clinically important ARG
    n_AMR   = n_distinct(`Gene symbol`),            # AMR gene count
    n_classes = n_distinct(Class),                  # AMR class count
    MDR     = as.integer(n_distinct(Class) >= 3),   # MDR threshold
    .groups = "drop"
  )

iso_pathotype_wide <- iso_pathotype_wide %>%
  left_join(iso_gene_flags, by = "name")

iso_pathotype_wide <- iso_pathotype_wide %>%
  left_join(iso_amr_summary, by = "name") %>%
  mutate(
    any_AMR  = replace_na(any_AMR, 0L),
    CIA      = replace_na(CIA, 0L),
    MDR      = replace_na(MDR, 0L),
    n_AMR    = replace_na(n_AMR, 0L),
    n_classes = replace_na(n_classes, 0L)
  )

# Helper: safely compute % for a possibly-missing pathotype column
pct_col <- function(data, col) {
  if (col %in% names(data)) mean(data[[col]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100 else 0
}

fmt_mean_sd <- function(x) {
  if (length(x[!is.na(x)]) > 1) {
    sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  } else {
    sprintf("%.1f", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  }
}

# ----------------------------
# 3) Summarise at ST level
#    (UPEC instead of ExPEC-like; includes NMEC)
# ----------------------------
# ---- 3) Add compact AMR columns to the ST summary (percentages)
st_summary <- iso_pathotype_wide %>%
  filter(!is.na(ST_new)) %>%
  group_by(ST_new) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Phylogroup = first(Consensus_phylogroup),

    `ColV (%)`  = mean(ColV == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    `senB (%)`  = mean(senB == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    `HPI (%)`   = mean(HPI == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    `stx (%)`   = mean(stx == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,

    `UPEC (%)` = if ("UPEC" %in% names(.)) mean(UPEC == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100 else 0,
    `NMEC (%)` = if ("NMEC" %in% names(.)) mean(NMEC == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100 else 0,
    `EPEC (%)` = if ("EPEC" %in% names(.)) mean(EPEC == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100 else 0,
    `EAEC (%)` = if ("EAEC" %in% names(.)) mean(EAEC == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100 else 0,
    `EIEC (%)` = if ("EIEC" %in% names(.)) mean(EIEC == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100 else 0,
    `ETEC (%)` = if ("ETEC" %in% names(.)) mean(ETEC == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100 else 0,
    `DAEC (%)` = if ("DAEC" %in% names(.)) mean(DAEC == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100 else 0,
    `EHEC (%)` = if ("EHEC" %in% names(.)) mean(EHEC == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100 else 0,

        # --- AMR
        `AMR genes` = fmt_mean_sd(n_AMR),
        `AMR classes` = fmt_mean_sd(n_classes),
            
        `intI1 (%)` = mean(intI1 == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
        `MDR (%)`   = mean(MDR == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
        `CIA (%)`   = mean(CIA == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100


  ) %>%
  rename(ST = ST_new, Count = n) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      ends_with("(%)"),
      ~ round(.x, 1)
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# 4) Identify top 10 hybrid STs
# ----------------------------
# Top 10 STs by isolate count
top10_sts <- st_summary %>%
  arrange(desc(Count)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

# Any additional STs with stx > 0% (but not already in top 10)
extra_stx_sts <- st_summary %>%
  filter(`stx (%)` > 0) %>%
  filter(!ST %in% top10_sts$ST) %>%
  arrange(desc(`stx (%)`), desc(Count))

# Combine
st_summary_top10_plus_stx <- bind_rows(top10_sts, extra_stx_sts)

readr::write_csv(st_summary_top10_plus_stx, figure_path("Table_1_regenerated.csv"))

st_summary_top10_plus_stx
```

```{r}
cohort_amr_summary <- amrfinder %>%
        filter(Scope == "core",
               `Element type` == "AMR",
               `Element subtype` == "AMR") %>%
        select(name, `Gene symbol`, Class, Subclass) %>%
        mutate(
                CIA = if_else(
                        `Gene symbol` %in% ARGs_of_interest |
                                Subclass %in% c("CARBAPENEM","CEPHALOSPORIN"),
                        1L,
                        0L
                )
        ) %>%
        group_by(name) %>%
        summarise(
                any_AMR = 1L,
                CIA = as.integer(any(CIA == 1L)),
                n_AMR = n_distinct(`Gene symbol`),
                n_classes = n_distinct(Class),
                MDR = as.integer(n_distinct(Class) >= 3),
                .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        right_join(sample_names, by = "name") %>%
        mutate(
                any_AMR = replace_na(any_AMR, 0L),
                CIA = replace_na(CIA, 0L),
                MDR = replace_na(MDR, 0L),
                n_AMR = replace_na(n_AMR, 0L),
                n_classes = replace_na(n_classes, 0L)
        ) %>%
        left_join(genometa %>%
                          select(name, Revised_Source_Niche, ST_new, Consensus_phylogroup),
                  by = "name")

cohort_amr_summary %>%
        summarise(
                n = n(),
                MDR_n = sum(MDR),
                MDR_percent = round(100 * mean(MDR), 2),
                CIA_n = sum(CIA),
                CIA_percent = round(100 * mean(CIA), 2),
                MDR_CIA_n = sum(MDR == 1 & CIA == 1),
                MDR_CIA_percent = round(100 * mean(MDR == 1 & CIA == 1), digits = 2)
        )
```

```{r}
cia_gene_counts_wide_with_total <- {
  
  cia_gene_source_table <- amrfinder %>%
    filter(
      Scope == "core",
      `Element type` == "AMR",
      `Element subtype` == "AMR"
    ) %>%
    select(name, `Gene symbol`, Class, Subclass) %>%
    mutate(
      CIA = if_else(
        `Gene symbol` %in% ARGs_of_interest |
          Subclass %in% c("CARBAPENEM", "CEPHALOSPORIN"),
        1L,
        0L
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(CIA == 1) %>%
    distinct(name, `Gene symbol`, Class, Subclass) %>%
    left_join(
      genometa %>%
        select(name, Revised_Source_Niche),
      by = "name"
    )
  
  source_totals <- genometa %>%
    filter(name %in% sample_names$name) %>%
    count(Revised_Source_Niche, name = "source_total")
  
  gene_total_counts <- cia_gene_source_table %>%
    distinct(name, Class, Subclass, `Gene symbol`) %>%
    count(Class, Subclass, `Gene symbol`, name = "total_count")
  
  cia_gene_source_table_grouped <- cia_gene_source_table %>%
    left_join(
      gene_total_counts,
      by = c("Class", "Subclass", "Gene symbol")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      `Gene symbol` = if_else(
        total_count < 3,
        "Other rare genes (<3 genomes total)",
        `Gene symbol`
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-total_count) %>%
    distinct(name, Class, Subclass, `Gene symbol`, Revised_Source_Niche)
  
  cia_gene_counts_wide <- cia_gene_source_table_grouped %>%
    count(Class, Subclass, `Gene symbol`, Revised_Source_Niche, name = "count") %>%
    left_join(source_totals, by = "Revised_Source_Niche") %>%
    mutate(
      percent = round(100 * count / source_total, 1),
      cell = paste0(count, " (", percent, "%)")
    ) %>%
    select(Class, Subclass, `Gene symbol`, Revised_Source_Niche, cell) %>%
    complete(
      nesting(Class, Subclass, `Gene symbol`),
      Revised_Source_Niche,
      fill = list(cell = "0 (0%)")
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Revised_Source_Niche,
      values_from = cell
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      Class,
      Subclass,
      `Gene symbol` == "Other rare genes (<3 genomes total)",
      `Gene symbol`
    )
  
  cia_source_total_row <- cia_gene_source_table %>%
    distinct(name, Revised_Source_Niche) %>%
    count(Revised_Source_Niche, name = "count") %>%
    left_join(source_totals, by = "Revised_Source_Niche") %>%
    mutate(
      percent = round(100 * count / source_total, 1),
      cell = paste0(count, " (", percent, "%)")
    ) %>%
    select(Revised_Source_Niche, cell) %>%
    complete(
      Revised_Source_Niche,
      fill = list(cell = "0 (0%)")
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Revised_Source_Niche,
      values_from = cell
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Class = "Total",
      Subclass = "Total",
      `Gene symbol` = "Total CIA-positive genomes"
    ) %>%
    select(Class, Subclass, `Gene symbol`, everything())
  
  bind_rows(
    cia_gene_counts_wide,
    cia_source_total_row
  )
}

readr::write_csv(cia_gene_counts_wide_with_total, figure_path("Table_2_regenerated.csv"))
```

```{r}

expec_summary <- genometa %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    afa_dra = any(c_across(matches("EC_custom_afaE-[13]|vfdb_dra[BC]$")) == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    iutA    = any(c_across(matches("colV_zoetis_iutA$|EC_custom_iutA_|vfdb_iutA$")) == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    kpsMII  = any(c_across(matches("EC_custom_kpsMT.*II")) == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    pap     = any(c_across(matches("EC_custom_pap[ACH]_|vfdb_pap[ACH]$")) == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sfa_foc = any(c_across(matches("vfdb_(sfa[DE]|focD)$")) == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    expec_markers = sum(c_across(afa_dra:sfa_foc)),
    ExPEC = expec_markers >= 2
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    ExPEC_n = sum(ExPEC),
    ExPEC_percent = round(100 * mean(ExPEC), 1)
  )

expec_summary

# Total number of isolates within each source niche
niche_totals <- genometa %>%
  distinct(name, Revised_Source_Niche) %>%
  count(Revised_Source_Niche, name = "n_total")

amrfinder <- amrfinder %>% filter(name %in% genometa$name)

# One source assignment per isolate
source_metadata <- genometa %>%
  distinct(name, Revised_Source_Niche)

# Denominator: all isolates in each source niche
source_totals <- source_metadata %>%
  count(Revised_Source_Niche, name = "total_isolates")

# Numerator: isolates carrying at least one established QRDR substitution
qrdr_by_source <- amrfinder %>%
  filter(
    `Element subtype` == "POINT",
    `Gene symbol` %in% established_qrdr
  ) %>%
  distinct(name) %>%
  inner_join(source_metadata, by = "name") %>%
  count(Revised_Source_Niche, name = "qrdr_positive") %>%
  right_join(source_totals, by = "Revised_Source_Niche") %>%
  mutate(
    qrdr_positive = replace_na(qrdr_positive, 0L),
    percent = 100 * qrdr_positive / total_isolates,
    result = sprintf(
      "%d/%d (%.2f%%)",
      qrdr_positive,
      total_isolates,
      percent
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Revised_Source_Niche)

qrdr_by_source
``` 
